ios.desc:
You save travel reels and never plan the trip. Borderly turns that inspiration into a real itinerary, then keeps the whole trip (plans, friends, flights) in one place.

TURN REELS INTO TRIPS
• Share a travel reel or video from Instagram or TikTok to Borderly
• Borderly pulls out the places and builds a trip plan on a map
• Save reels and places for later and add them to any trip

PLAN WITH AI
• Tell the assistant where you're going and get a day-by-day itinerary
• See every stop on the map, reorder days, add or swap activities
• Add your trip to your calendar and share the plan in one tap

PLAN TOGETHER
• Create a group trip and invite friends with a code
• Collect RSVPs so you know who's actually coming
• Vote on dates, places, and activities with quick polls
• Drop ideas in a shared brainstorm bin and lock in the winners

TRACK EVERY FLIGHT
• Scan or upload boarding passes to build your flight history
• Watch your miles, cities, and countries add up on your map
• Earn badges and see how you rank against other travelers
• Dig into your analytics: routes, airlines, seats, and timing

FREE TO START
Your first 3 trip plans are free. Upgrade to Borderly Pro for unlimited trip plans.

BORDERLY PRO SUBSCRIPTION
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
• Your subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage or cancel anytime in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

By subscribing, you agree to our Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ and Privacy Policy: https://borderlyai.com

show_hn.title: Show HN: Boarding Pass Wallet with Leaderboard, Analytics and Trip Planning

quotes.text:
Hi Guys,

A long time ago, I began collecting my boarding passes. I've always been a travel fanatic. I thought I'd love to build a travel app that is more than just flight bookings. This is a way to store your travel memories.

I've gamified it a little bit by adding a leaderboard. It's optional as well. Just upload your boarding pass and Borderly does the rest.

I'd love for you guys to try and give me feedback. I'm also open to new features and ideas to make it as comprehensive and fun as possible.

I'm planning to make a "Make it out of the group chat" feature where you can plan with friends and also record and split expenses while on a trip.

It's available on the Apple App Store:
https://apps.apple.com/in/app/borderly/id6753683444it
